name: To eat a god
source:
You will control a puppet during your stay in the game, you must blend in with your role to prevent a break with the continuity of the game itself and with the psyche of the characters within it....

[From [url=https://soffis-mbm.itch.io/to-eat-a-god]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在游戏中你将控制一个木偶，你必须融入你的角色，以防止破坏游戏本身的连续性以及游戏中角色的心理……

[来自[url=https://soffis-mbm.itch.io/to-eat-a-god]itch.io[/url]]
